style: Flat vector-style illustration for a modern service website. Simple geometric shapes, clean outlines, subtle soft shadows, limited palette of indigo, coral and soft yellow on light neutrals, friendly and uncluttered.
people: When people appear, draw simplified characters without detailed facial features, in a consistent flat style.
constraints: One coherent illustration. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. No UI screenshots with readable content. Keep edges clean so the image works on light backgrounds.
